translation: admittedly, it's true (... but); und zwar: namely

meanings.gloss: zwar ... aber: admittedly ..., but; it's true ..., but

sentences.text: Das Auto ist zwar alt, aber es fährt noch gut.
sentences.en: The car may be old, but it still runs well.

sentences.text: Ich habe zwar wenig Zeit, aber ich kann dir helfen.
sentences.en: I don't have much time, but I can help you.
sentences.review: The translation drops the concessive force of zwar, which this meaning is meant to teach; suggest 'I may not have much time, but I can help you.'

sentences.text: Sie ist zwar jung, aber sie weiß eine Menge.
sentences.en: She may be young, but she knows a lot.

sentences.text: Es ist zwar spät, aber ich bin nicht müde.
sentences.en: It's late, it's true, but I'm not tired.

sentences.text: Ich kenne ihn zwar, aber nicht gut.
sentences.en: I do know him, but not well.

sentences.text: Der Plan ist zwar einfach, aber er ist gut.
sentences.en: The plan may be simple, but it's good.

meanings.gloss: und zwar: namely, specifically; and (right now)

sentences.en: Come here, and I mean right now!

sentences.text: Ich brauche Hilfe, und zwar jetzt.
sentences.en: I need help, and I need it now.

sentences.text: Wir fahren nach Rom, und zwar morgen.
sentences.en: We're going to Rome, tomorrow in fact.

sentences.text: Ich habe ein Problem, und zwar mit meinem Auto.
sentences.en: I have a problem, namely with my car.
sentences.review: 'I have a problem, namely with my car' is stilted English; suggest 'I have a problem, and it's with my car.' or 'I have a problem – with my car, that is.'

meanings.notes: REVIEW warning: The gloss part 'and (right now)' is confusing and only reflects one example; suggest 'und zwar: namely, specifically; (emphatic) and I mean ...'.
